Essentials
Flights

Out, British Airways: BA0186 Austin (AUS) Monday September 21 at 10:30 PM to Heathrow (LHR) Terminal 5, lands 1:55 PM September 22, Club World. Connect at Terminal 5, about 5 hours. BA0522 Heathrow 7:05 PM to Florence Peretola (FLR), lands 10:20 PM, Club Europe. Two checked bags at 32 kg each on both legs. Arno Travel’s transfer meets you outside baggage claim with an ECCELLENZE sign and takes you to Borgo Pignano Florence. Home: United KYMT99 was cancelled September 19 and refunded in full. The return on October 16 is rebooked on points, details to follow.

Rental car

Avis #26405920US2. Fiat 600, automatic, unlimited km. Pick up Florence Vespucci (FLR) Friday September 25, booked for 9:00 AM, move to 12:00. Drop Rome Fiumicino (FCO), booked for Saturday October 10 at 12:00 PM, extend to Sunday October 11 around 1:00 PM. $1,358.61 prepaid plus the extra day. No car from October 11 onward; Arno Travel asked to help with transfers for the Amalfi leg.

Why this trip

Italy collection for Suites With Keith / Fora, releasing print and digital February / March 2027. Eccellenze hosts the first two Florence nights. Everything after is site inspections, shoots and hosted or paid stays.

Drive times

Tuscany to Portofino about 3 hours. Portofino to Cernobbio about 2 hours 45. Como to the Dolomites about 3 hours. Alpe di Siusi to Montalcino about 4 hours 30, the longest day. Val d’Orcia to Rome about 2 hours 30. Rome to Positano about 3 hours.

Pace

This is a sketch, not a schedule. Slow mornings, gym and breakfast, no hotel departures before 11:00. One property visit a day is the target, two is the ceiling, and where you are staying counts as seen. Times on the page are suggestions to steer replies toward, not commitments. If a day feels full, drop the second stop.
